question_text:
Describe a person who has influenced you a lot.
You should say:
• who this person is
• how you know this person
• what this person is like
and explain why this person has influenced you so much.

Describe a teacher who made a positive difference to your life.
You should say:
• who this teacher was
• what subject he or she taught
• what his or her lessons were like
and explain why this teacher made such a difference to you.

Describe a friend you have known for a long time.
You should say:
• who this friend is
• how and when you first met
• what you usually do together
and explain why your friendship has lasted so long.

Describe an older person you enjoy spending time with.
You should say:
• who this person is
• how you know him or her
• what you usually do together
and explain why you enjoy spending time with this person.

Describe a famous person you would like to meet.
You should say:
• who this person is
• how you first heard about him or her
• what you would talk about if you met
and explain why you would like to meet this person.

Describe someone you know who is very good at their job.
You should say:
• who this person is
• what job he or she does
• how you know about his or her work
and explain why you think this person is so good at the job.

Describe a quiet place where you like to spend time.
You should say:
• where this place is
• how often you go there
• what you do there
and explain why you like spending time in this place.

Describe a beautiful natural place you have visited.
You should say:
• where it is
• when you went there
• what you saw and did there
and explain why you found this place so beautiful.

Describe a city you would like to visit in the future.
You should say:
• which city it is
• how you learned about it
• what you would like to do there
and explain why you would like to visit this city.

Describe a building in your town or city that you find interesting.
You should say:
• where the building is
• what it looks like
• what it is used for
and explain why you find this building interesting.

Describe a restaurant or cafe you enjoy going to.
You should say:
• where it is
• how often you go there
• what kind of food or drinks it serves
and explain why you enjoy going there.

Describe an object that is important to you.
You should say:
• what the object is
• where you got it from
• how long you have had it
and explain why this object is so important to you.

Describe a piece of technology you find very useful.
You should say:
• what it is
• when you got it
• how often you use it
and explain why you find it so useful.

Describe a gift you received that was special to you.
You should say:
• what the gift was
• who gave it to you
• when you received it
and explain why this gift was so special to you.

Describe a piece of clothing you enjoy wearing.
You should say:
• what it is
• where you got it
• when you usually wear it
and explain why you enjoy wearing it.

Describe a photograph that means a lot to you.
You should say:
• what is in the photograph
• when and where it was taken
• who took it
and explain why this photograph is meaningful to you.

Describe a celebration you attended that you really enjoyed.
You should say:
• what the celebration was
• where and when it took place
• who was there
and explain why you enjoyed it so much.

Describe a memorable journey you have made.
You should say:
• where you went
• how you travelled
• who you travelled with
and explain why this journey was so memorable.

Describe a time when you had to wait a long time for something.
You should say:
• what you were waiting for
• where you were
• how long you had to wait
and explain how you felt while you were waiting.

Describe a time when you helped someone.
You should say:
• who you helped
• when and where it happened
• how you helped this person
and explain how you felt after helping this person.

Describe a time when you were pleasantly surprised.
You should say:
• what the surprise was
• when it happened
• who was involved
and explain how you felt about this surprise.

Describe a mistake you made that taught you something important.
You should say:
• what the mistake was
• when it happened
• what the consequences were
and explain what you learned from this mistake.

Describe a hobby you enjoy.
You should say:
• what the hobby is
• when and how you started it
• how often you do it
and explain why you enjoy this hobby.

Describe a sport or physical activity you would like to try.
You should say:
• what it is
• where you could do it
• what equipment or training you would need
and explain why you would like to try it.

Describe a skill you would like to learn.
You should say:
• what the skill is
• how you would learn it
• how long you think it would take to learn
and explain why you would like to learn this skill.

Describe a day out with your family or friends that you particularly enjoyed.
You should say:
• where you went
• who you were with
• what you did
and explain why you enjoyed this day so much.

Describe a book you have read and enjoyed.
You should say:
• what the book is about
• when you read it
• why you decided to read it
and explain why you enjoyed reading this book.

Describe a film that made a strong impression on you.
You should say:
• what the film was
• when and where you watched it
• what it was about
and explain why it made such a strong impression on you.

Describe a website or app that you use often.
You should say:
• what it is
• how you found out about it
• what you use it for
and explain why you find it so useful.

Describe a piece of news that you found interesting.
You should say:
• what the news was about
• when you heard about it
• how you found out about it
and explain why you found this piece of news interesting.

Describe a song or piece of music that is special to you.
You should say:
• what it is
• when you first heard it
• how often you listen to it
and explain why this song or piece of music is special to you.

Describe an advertisement that you remember well.
You should say:
• what was being advertised
• where you saw or heard it
• what the advertisement showed
and explain why you remember it so well.

Describe a difficult decision you once had to make.
You should say:
• what the decision was
• when you had to make it
• what options you had
and explain how you finally made your decision.

Describe a time when you changed your mind about something.
You should say:
• what you changed your mind about
• when this happened
• what made you change your mind
and explain how you feel about this change now.

Describe an achievement you are proud of.
You should say:
• what you achieved
• when you achieved it
• how you achieved it
and explain why you are proud of this achievement.

Describe a goal you hope to achieve in the next few years.
You should say:
• what the goal is
• when you first decided on it
• what you are doing to achieve it
and explain why this goal is important to you.

Describe a piece of good advice someone gave you.
You should say:
• who gave you the advice
• when you received it
• what the advice was
and explain how this advice helped you.

Describe a change that would improve your local area.
You should say:
• what the change would be
• how it could be made
• who would benefit from it
and explain why this change would improve the area.

Describe a positive change you have made in your life.
You should say:
• what the change was
• when you made it
• why you decided to make it
and explain how this change has affected your life.

Describe a rule that you think is important.
You should say:
• what the rule is
• where this rule applies
• what happens if people break it
and explain why you think this rule is important.
